topic: Retag has no Orch.app control, no way to clear a retag, and its row outlives a deleted source
detail: SP-071's summary mentions the UI; this lane added the RPC and 'orch spaces retag' only. A retag cannot be cleared (the operator can only retag the source again), and deleting a source (DeleteSource, a docs purge or a prune) leaves its spaces_retags row, so a later write of the same URI follows the old retag under the rules in docs/internals/memory.md 'Retag'. Proposed: a retag control in Orch.app's Spaces pane (SP-028's quarantine view can call RetagSource with expect_from), 'orch spaces retag --clear', and removing the row when its source is deleted.
